components.name: O*NET Database
components.role: occupation, task, skill and work-context benchmark
components.trust_boundary: US benchmark only; never proves a Chinese JD requirement or vacancy status

components.name: ESCO
components.license: EU reuse policy; local API EUPL-1.2
components.role: occupation-skill graph and stable skill identifiers
components.trust_boundary: European taxonomy without official Chinese labels; preserve original Chinese JD wording

components.name: Docling
components.role: local PDF, DOCX, HTML, table and layout parsing
components.input: local candidate document or JD file
components.output: structured JSON or Markdown for evidence extraction
components.trust_boundary: parser output must be checked against the original document; keep private files local

components.name: Crawl4AI
components.role: public official-page extraction to Markdown or structured records
components.output: page content, metadata and extraction status
components.trust_boundary: respect site terms and robots; no login, paywall or anti-bot bypass; pin security-reviewed releases

components.name: Tabiya Open Dataset
components.license: ESCO/EU data reuse terms; no standalone repository license
components.trust_boundary: contains ESCO 1.1.1 and is older than the baseline ESCO release

components.name: Tabiya Livelihoods Classifier
components.license: MIT code and models; CC-BY-4.0 and source-specific datasets
components.role: occupation, skill, qualification, experience and domain entity linking
components.output: candidate ESCO-linked entities with model trace
components.trust_boundary: requires model access and human review; classification is not eligibility evidence

components.name: Datalab ESCO Skill Extractor
components.license: MIT; ESCO data under EU terms
components.role: two-stage occupation matching and JD skill-to-ESCO linking
components.output: occupation candidates and linked skill candidates
components.trust_boundary: LLM and embedding outputs are suggestions; preserve phrases and review mappings

components.name: Tabiya Compass
components.role: guided discovery of skills from formal and informal experience
components.output: candidate skill claims awaiting evidence confirmation
components.trust_boundary: never turn conversational inference into resume fact without user confirmation

components.name: Resume Matcher
components.role: JD gap analysis and resume-tailoring interaction pattern
components.trust_boundary: similarity is not employment probability; every rewrite needs evidence references

components.name: JobSpy
components.license: MIT; website content remains subject to platform terms
components.role: candidate discovery on selected overseas job platforms
components.trust_boundary: do not collect contact details or evade blocks; return to official JD before selection

components.name: MELO Benchmark
components.license: MIT; included data retains source-specific terms
components.trust_boundary: benchmark performance does not prove Chinese-market accuracy

components.name: TGRE Classification
components.license: MIT; model, API and upstream data terms vary
components.role: taxonomy-guided O*NET and ESCO retrieval and reranking experiments
components.output: ranked taxonomy candidates and raw trace
components.trust_boundary: research evaluation only; not vacancy or eligibility evidence
